file.description: Repo-relative path, e.g. tests/test_x.py. No leading ./, absolute path or line number. A short label such as 'git history' for history-level findings.

test.description: Bare test function name, e.g. test_x (no (), no file:: prefix, no [param] suffix), or null for a file-level or repo-level finding.

category.description: Short name of the defect class.

summary.description: Why it is a defect. One finding per defect; defects only, no positive notes.
